text:
Alia: MediBridge Health asked for SOC 2 and ISO artifacts + a signed pen-test authorization before we spin up their POC. They also want to know cost difference Dedicated vs Private and whether customer-managed KMS changes pricing. Can we assemble a plan?

Mike: We can pull SOC2 attestation + ISO certs and produce a presigned bundle. Pen-test letter needs Legal sign-off; Security must confirm scope. If they require customer-managed KMS for staging, that increases setup work.

Jana: Clarify deployment target: Dedicated (reserved GPUs) or Private (VPC/on-prem)? Dedicated ~3 business days to provision after approvals; Private/on-prem is several weeks.

Alia: Customer said "isolation + KMS control" is the requirement and theyre flexible on Dedicated vs Private; prefer Dedicated if cost delta is small.

Mike: Draft pen-test auth template to hand to Legal: 
```
Pen-test Authorization - MediBridge POC
- Customer: MediBridge Health
- Scope: app + network for POC CIDR/IPs to be provided
- Test window: tentative 2024-12-02 to 2024-12-06
- Exclusions: physical/social engineering
- Contact: security@redwood.com
- Requirements: proof of insurance, indemnity clause
- Signatures: Redwood Legal + Customer
```

Lee: Pricing: if they want Dedicated + isolated KMS + permissioned pen-test, recommend a one-time assurance/setup fee of $8,250 (covers KMS onboarding, network isolation, and security review). Dedicated runtime pricing unchanged; this is a separate setup charge.

Alia: Please upload the SOC2/ISO PDFs and share presigned link for MediBridge to review before signing.

AuditBot: upload complete: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/medibridge/2678901234/artifacts.zip (expires in 7 days)

Mike: Looping Legal: @Rachel can you review the pen-test template and confirm indemnity language?

Rachel: I can sign once Security finalizes scope and we confirm acceptable indemnity wording. Send final test window and customer insurance confirmation.

Jana: If they accept the assurance fee and confirm Dedicated, infra can be ready in ~3 business days. If Private/on-prem chosen, plan for 3+ weeks and procurement touchpoints.

Alia: I'll reply to MediBridge with the artifact link, pen-test template asking them to confirm scope and dates, and the $8,250 one-time assurance fee if they need KMS separation. Ask them to pick Dedicated vs Private and confirm insurance by EOD Thu.

Lee: I'll add the assurance line to the quote and notify Billing once customer acknowledges.

Alia: Thanks team :thumbsup: will paste customer reply here when received.
